sourceFidelity.description: When you paste a document, send back a reply that adds figures (amounts, dates, percentages) the document never stated and no tool returned.

heartbeatDir.description: Each pack writes <pack>.txt here at session start, read by /guardrails-status and the outside watchdog. '~' is your home folder. Empty turns it off.
